approvalText: I approve the Phase 1H-A Photoroom benchmark: 20 clean + 3 empty + 3 multi-subject + 3 badly occluded synthetic fixtures, exactly 29 maximum external calls, zero retries, maximum cost $0.58, expected 30–90 seconds, and upload of only those repository-generated PNG fixtures. I accept that Photoroom excludes API images from training but does not publish an exact transient API-image deletion interval.
dataLeavingMachine: Only the 29 repository-generated 480 x 480 PNG fixture inputs
